translated_text: 据阿肯色州警方称，在阿肯色州卡姆登警方追捕一辆载有四名幼儿（其中包括一名 4 个月大婴儿）的汽车时，警方试图拦下违反交通规则的司机，结果发生翻车事故。警方称婴儿被从车内弹出

text: Missing Auburn University student James "Weston" Higginbotham was found dead outside of Kyoto, his mother said Saturday on Facebook. He was found in a mountainous area by a volunteer search-and-rescue group, his mom said. A cause of death or more details were not immediately
translated_text: 失踪的奥本大学学生詹姆斯·“韦斯顿”·希金博瑟姆被发现死在京都郊外，他的母亲周六在脸书上表示。他的妈妈说，他是在山区被志愿搜救队发现的。死因或更多细节尚未立即公布

text: Iran on Saturday accused the U.S. of violating the fragile ceasefire as the U.S. military reported that it had shot down six Iranian one-way attack drones over the past two days that were headed toward the Strait of Hormuz.
translated_text: 伊朗周六指责美国违反了脆弱的停火协议，美国军方报告称，过去两天击落了六架伊朗单向攻击无人机，这些无人机正飞往霍尔木兹海峡。

text: President Trump told farmers in rural Wisconsin on Friday that an economic rebound is coming, and told them they're "going to see some very good things happen over the next 90-day period." The president also touted the higher-than-expected employment figures for May.
translated_text: 特朗普总统周五告诉威斯康星州农村地区的农民，经济反弹即将到来，并告诉他们“在接下来的 90 天内将看到一些非常好的事情发生”。总统还称赞五月份的就业数据高于预期。

text: Israeli troops killed a seven-month-old Palestinian baby boy after firing at his parents' vehicle in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian health ministry said.
translated_text: 巴勒斯坦卫生部表示，以色列军队在被占领的约旦河西岸向一名七个月大的巴勒斯坦男婴开枪打死了他父母的车辆。

text: Pakistan's interior minister, Mohsen Naqvi, visited Iran on Saturday for talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, an Iranian news agency reports.
translated_text: 据伊朗通讯社报道，巴基斯坦内政部长穆赫森·纳克维周六访问伊朗，与伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇举行会谈。

text: Demonstrators rallied against a billion-dollar resort development in Albania linked to Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump for a seventh consecutive day.
translated_text: 示威者连续第七天集会反对与贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普有关的阿尔巴尼亚耗资十亿美元的度假村开发项目。

text: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used a D-Day anniversary speech on Saturday to appear to link immigration by sea to the wartime liberation of Europe.
translated_text: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯在周六的诺曼底登陆周年纪念演讲中似乎将海上移民与欧洲战时解放联系起来。

text: Some Facebook users may soon get a second payout tied to Meta's privacy settlement. Here's when and how much.
translated_text: 一些 Facebook 用户可能很快就会获得与 Meta 隐私和解相关的第二笔付款。这是时间和金额。

text: The FBI has fired at least five analysts who were involved in the creation of a withdrawn internal 2023 intelligence memo on "Radical Traditionalist Catholic" ideology, sources said.
translated_text: 消息人士称，FBI 解雇了至少 5 名分析师，他们参与了一份已撤回的 2023 年内部情报备忘录的制定，内容涉及“激进传统天主教”意识形态。

text: SCOOP — Sens. Cotton & Grassley ask Rubio to “plan for a potential significant gap in foreign intelligence collection” as Senate Dems block FISA 702 extension over Pulte appointment as acting DNI. Deadline is next Friday.
translated_text: 独家新闻 — 由于参议院民主党阻止 FISA 702 延长 Pulte 代理国家情报总监的任命，Cotton & Grassley 参议员要求卢比奥“为外国情报收集方面可能出现的重大缺口做好计划”。截止日期是下周五。
